title: TypeProbe: Recovering Type Representations from Hidden States of Pre-trained Code Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.08339v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art code models achieve impressive performance, yet the extent to which they internally encode type information remains poorly understood. We probe the residual streams of pretrained code models for internal type representations using a parallel dataset of Java and Python code examples. Our results show that cross-lingual type representations emerge even from untyped code. Moreover, we test whether hidden states linearly encode the result type implied by typed function application by training probes on one language to infer argument and result types in the other. Finally, we find that this structure is partly robust to lexical perturbations and cross-language syntactic variations. To the best of our knowledge, prior work on interpretability of code models has not directly targeted formal type semantics or cross-lingual type representations. We release our code and datasets.

translated_title: TypeProbe：从预训练代码模型的隐藏状态中恢复类型表示
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2607.08339v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：最先进的代码模型取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但它们在内部编码类型信息的程度仍鲜为人知。我们使用Java和Python代码示例的平行数据集，探测预训练代码模型的残差流以获取内部类型表示。我们的结果表明，即使从无类型代码中也能涌现出跨语言类型表示。此外，我们通过在一个语言上训练探针来推断另一种语言中的参数和结果类型，测试隐藏状态是否线性编码了类型化函数应用所隐含的结果类型。最后，我们发现这种结构部分对词汇扰动和跨语言句法变化具有鲁棒性。据我们所知，先前关于代码模型可解释性的工作并未直接针对形式类型语义或跨语言类型表示。我们发布了我们的代码和数据集。
tldr: 本文通过探测预训练代码模型的隐藏状态，首次揭示了跨语言类型表示能从无类型代码中涌现，并验证了其线性编码及对扰动的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper probes hidden states of pretrained code models to reveal, for the first time, that cross-lingual type representations emerge from untyped code, with linear encoding and robustness to perturbations.
